title: RAW finite Galen writer: a negated category frame requires one food argument, not an arbitrary intervening word
summary: RAW_UNREVIEWED_NOT_EXECUTED. The full IDEA499/501 readings contain sshey lshedy and or shedy lshedy for negation of the solid-food predicate. A new, explicitly narrow writer admits either a context-supplied argument or one written atomic food argument between a frozen NOT form and lshedy. Its actual falsifier is a previously typed non-food value in that prebound written slot. Novel combinations are permitted, not predicted to occur. All 59 guessed values stay unchanged; opaque slot syntax remains a rival even if every observed case is compatible.

design.mechanism: Two-stage composition: first apply SOLID_FOOD to one food-denoting argument; then apply one unchanged propositional NOT operator to the resulting proposition. A fixed local writer spells these operations as N A lshedy, or N lshedy when the argument is explicitly left to discourse context.
design.unit: Every prebound local N X lshedy or N lshedy trigger in the fixed owned paragraph packet, retained inside its complete paragraph and actual physical line.
design.contrast: Typed local writer with one atomic food argument versus the same opaque N SLOT lshedy bracket grammar accepting arbitrary intervening whole forms. Both can reproduce the two development phrases; only the typed writer excludes a frozen non-food input at X.
design.prediction: Whenever a primary-eligible observed N X lshedy trigger has X in the already fixed 59-entry vocabulary with a decisively incompatible type, the new writer rejects that complete observed local frame. One such literal case is a counterexample to its strict universal rule. The opaque slot grammar can retain the same raw frame.
design.not_a_prediction: Neither writer promises that any permitted recombinant string will occur. No new combination, no eligible frame, or only unknown X values cannot be counted as rejection or success of synonymy. Finding food-compatible X values tests compatibility of this added syntax, not the literal SOLID_FOOD interpretation.

freeze_and_scope.status: Written before any new paragraph content, target frequency census, frame search or score for this question. Existing project exposure remains; no blind or reserve claim.

lexicon.invariant: Every full denotation, type, existing subject identity and scope requirement is unchanged. No cooking, clock, music or transport meaning is imported. Original whole productions retain their old bindings; this proposal adds a new cross-context local writing law, not a replacement translation.

freeze_and_scope.development: Exclude complete physical leaves 76 and 80 from any future new-case claim. Both motivating full paragraphs and all their alternatives remain development evidence, not scored tests.

complete_paragraphs.full_reading: The existing comparative/epistemic Galen account, including its own productions, subject reference and separate comparison and reportability scopes.
The existing naming-dispute Galen account and its final solid-food negation; earlier audience and naming negations keep their own distinct scopes.

short_frame.old_meaning: NOT applied to SOLID_FOOD(C), with C bound by the unchanged full parent construction.

long_frame.old_meaning: NOT(SOLID_FOOD(C)); explicit shedy supplies the old cabbage food-kind C. The preceding dal remains THIS_FOOD(C), not an independently adjustable subject.

literal_development_binding.known_scope_countercase: IDEA501 also has oltydy NOT inside the rhetorical audience frame before ysheeyqorar CURRENT_GREEKS; IDEA499 has sol NOT before the separate good-juice and reportability constructions. Therefore NOT does not generally select food, nor is every N X sequence this food frame. Only the exact declared right anchor lshedy and fixed zero/one-group distance trigger the new law.

food_compatible_forms.qokopy: existing deictic food reference to C
food_compatible_forms.dal: existing deictic food reference to C
food_compatible_forms.aiin: the already declared nominal restriction identifying active vegetable C; no new predicate-to-noun coercion is introduced

finite_writer.food_compatibility_limit: The last three forms require their old discourse/nominal bindings. Their inclusion means that a food argument is type-possible under an already allowed use; it does not prove a correct antecedent in a new paragraph. Their full bindings must remain explicitly unresolved unless the complete context supplies them.
finite_writer.type_open_form: olor is a Plant R but is not automatically a food. It is OPEN_TYPE for this test, neither licensed as a food nor counted as a proved incompatible value.
finite_writer.fixed_incompatible_set: Every other form of the exact 59-entry parent inventory, after removing the eight food-compatible forms and olor, is incompatible with the writer's ONE_ATOMIC_FOOD slot. This is a formal type restriction: uninstantiated predicates, relations, proposition operators, profiles, times, names, human communities, faculties, and the pair-valued BOTH_FOODS are not a single supplied food-kind value. No silent application, metonymy, singleton projection, pointwise lifting or quotation may convert them.
finite_writer.outputs: The bounded known-vocabulary writer has 32 long surfaces N A lshedy (4 N choices times 8 A forms) and four short surfaces N lshedy, with spaces preserved exactly. No subword edits, letter meanings, fused spellings or new whole values are generated.
finite_writer.long_reduction: A supplies one Food term F; lshedy(F) yields a proposition; N applies to that proposition. The writer chooses N's surface from its four existing exact values and realizes the argument before the predicate. These are two ordered semantic applications, not a whole-clause macro.
finite_writer.short_reduction: An external active Food term F is required; N lshedy does not create or identify F. A short frame alone cannot establish the subject or complete the surrounding paragraph.
finite_writer.local_trigger_law: For every literal same-line occurrence of lshedy, inspect exactly its two preceding complete groups where present. If the group two positions before is in N, recognize the LONG trigger and take the immediate predecessor as X. This longest-trigger choice is fixed even if X is itself in N. Otherwise, if the immediate predecessor is in N, recognize SHORT. Otherwise the occurrence is OUTSIDE_CONTRACT. No wider gap, reordered frame, punctuation-normalized frame or per-occurrence parser fallback.
finite_writer.why_trigger_is_extra: The two parent examples do not prove automatic local constituent boundaries or productivity. Declaring every LONG trigger to be this atomic-argument constituent is the strongest new assumption. A nested negation, intervening operator or accidental cross-clause adjacency can be well formed under a rival grammar and still refute THIS local law without changing any old word meaning.
finite_writer.conditional_domain: The typed middle-slot claim is conditional on X belonging to the frozen 59-form inventory. It is not a claim that the whole manuscript or every unknown food name must be generated by the 36 bounded known-vocabulary surfaces. Unknown X therefore stays outside typed discrimination; it must not be silently assigned a meaning or counted as food.

opaque_rivals.slot_grammar: Use the same fixed local trigger, but treat X as an arbitrary opaque whole-form slot. It accepts both food-compatible and incompatible old forms and makes no claim that the slot denotes a food. Compatible cases cannot distinguish the literal meaning from this structural rival.
opaque_rivals.whole_phrase_memory: Retain the two development phrases as exact lexicalized constructions, with other phrases unresolved. This rival does not predict that missing recombinant strings are ungrammatical and therefore cannot be rejected merely because a new combination is found.
opaque_rivals.scope_rival: A LONG surface can instead span two constructions or contain a further operator, including nested NOT. That rival adds a different constituent/scope rule. It must remain a stated alternative, never an invisible exception in the frozen local writer.
opaque_rivals.no_weak_null: No uniform random-word probability, automatic significance, arbitrary escape probability or made-up occurrence expectation is introduced. This first finite contract is a direct conditional falsifier, not a claim of positive statistical meaning identification.

prebound_census_recipe.source: Use only the hash-bound owned paragraph packet. No new TSV query, image, reserve or source collection.
prebound_census_recipe.readers: Process ZL3b, IT2a and RF1b separately. RF1b is already known to contain no complete paragraphs and stays NO_OWNED_PARAGRAPH_DATA. Never pool readings as independent witnesses.
prebound_census_recipe.selector_guard: Before examining paragraph words, reject f84-prefixed page selectors, f116v, and development physical leaves 76 or 80. Require the supplied leaf to agree with the selector. Keep every remaining complete paragraph and its original boundaries in the scope denominator.
prebound_census_recipe.literal_event_eligibility: A primary local frame lies wholly inside one stored line whose anchor_eligible is exactly true. A false, missing or nonboolean flag makes all apparent triggers on that line SOURCE_UNCERTAIN. They remain reported inside the complete unchanged paragraph and are never converted into contradictions. No individual group deletion, crossing a line boundary or rebuilding a paragraph. Uncertain OTHER lines of the same paragraph remain visible; they do not change the three literal local positions because this test uses no whole-paragraph mention rank or antecedent census.
prebound_census_recipe.not_a_1031_repair: Line-level eligibility follows the local literal-window unit, as in the earlier GDT928 anchor definition. It is frozen here before the new census and applies only to this different exact-frame/type law. It does not rerun 1031, change its whole-paragraph gate, reuse its scores or expand its synonym shortening rule.
prebound_census_recipe.denominator: Enumerate every lshedy occurrence and classify it as LONG, SHORT, OUTSIDE_CONTRACT or SOURCE_UNCERTAIN. Every primary LONG trigger is retained, irrespective of X identity. Classify X as FOOD_TYPE_POSSIBLE, FIXED_TYPE_CONFLICT, OPEN_TYPE(olor) or UNKNOWN_WORD(outside the 59). Do not select only the eight predicted food forms before materializing the denominator.
prebound_census_recipe.adverse_example_schema: A newly encountered literal complete context containing or qoky lshedy would be a LONG trigger with X=qoky, whose fixed value IS has type entity × predicate -> proposition. Without an explicitly forbidden new application/coercion, that is not one Food argument. This is an illustrative predicted counterexample shape, NOT a claim that the manuscript contains it. A raw or sol lshedy would likewise trigger the declared longest rule and expose the nested-NOT rival.
prebound_census_recipe.artifacts: One small census table with exact source IDs, all four outcome classes, every paragraph ID and local raw frame; whole surrounding paragraphs remain losslessly available by hash/ID in the original packet. Any displayed reading of the complete context must retain all unknown groups, original subjects and unresolved scopes. Do not copy a large source packet or generate prose filling those gaps.
prebound_census_recipe.new_combinations: List exact typed-compatible surfaces absent from the two development phrases, and their physical leaves, descriptively. Their mere presence is neither proof of semantic equivalence nor rejection of the whole-phrase-memory rival. Their absence is never a failure criterion.

fixed_outcomes.no_events: No primary LONG trigger outside the two development leaves: NO_CAPACITY for this new conditional falsifier, regardless of SHORT counts. No wider frame or different predicate follows automatically.
fixed_outcomes.only_open: LONG triggers exist but all X values are OPEN_TYPE or UNKNOWN_WORD: NO_TYPED_DISCRIMINATION. The corpus census is complete, but it supplies no fixed-type counterexample; no new gloss may be fitted during this test.
fixed_outcomes.counterexample: At least one primary LONG trigger has FIXED_TYPE_CONFLICT: reject the strict local writer plus its unchanged lexical typing for that transcription. Show the full surrounding paragraph reference and the exact conflicting parent entry. A source-uncertain row does not meet this condition. Alternate-reader disagreement makes the result reading-specific; no global semantic disproof.
fixed_outcomes.compatible_only: At least one FOOD_TYPE_POSSIBLE LONG trigger and no primary fixed-type conflict: observed cases are compatible with the narrow writer; opaque slot syntax and other meanings remain unseparated. Label CONDITIONAL_COMPATIBILITY_ONLY, never meaning confirmed or independent semantic PASS. Report open/unknown cases alongside compatible cases.
fixed_outcomes.mixed: Compatible and conflicting primary rows together still reject the strict universal writer. Frequency, extra compatible cases, alternate spellings, or an unparsed remainder cannot cancel the counterexample.
fixed_outcomes.scope_of_rejection: Only this added maximal local constituent/type rule is rejected. It does not separately refute NOT, SOLID_FOOD, CABBAGE, either whole parent reading, or any arbitrary broader grammar. No per-locus rescue or extra coercion is licensed.

complete_freedom_account.inherited: 59 unconfirmed lexical values, existing synonym identities and the parents' productions/subject bindings. Their original fitting costs remain; none becomes a known word.
complete_freedom_account.new: One right-anchor choice lshedy; the four existing NOT forms as a fixed trigger class; two local construction shapes; one longest-trigger convention; an eight-member type-possible food set with three explicitly reference-dependent members; one OPEN_TYPE form; a strict zero-coercion, zero-hidden-application atomic slot; exact one-line scope; two complete development-leaf exclusions.
complete_freedom_account.numeric_fit: Zero fitted probabilities, coefficients, unknown meanings, additional synonym groups, state-world simulations or per-form exceptions. No assumption that all legal outputs must occur.
complete_freedom_account.positive_knowledge_used: Words can compose in directed order, but exact whole and context residuals remain necessary. This is a testable narrow local composition hypothesis anchored to an existing full reading, not a claim that all morphology or syntax is transparent.
complete_freedom_account.strongest_countercase: The inherited NOT operator already appears in non-food propositions and can in principle scope over other operators. Therefore the right-anchor/local-constituent condition is indispensable and independently falsifiable; it must not be generalized silently to all NOT contexts.

predecessors.difference: Concrete refinement of the existing general argument-type/coercion proposal: a named right anchor, exact trigger forms, finite frozen type inventory, explicit incompatible cases and complete census denominator replace an unspecified operation/class pairing. This is no claim that selectional typing itself is novel.

The prior typed writer has source operators but no target component binding. Here every focal whole and argument type comes from an existing exact whole-reading draft; no Cennini meanings or process-world simulator is imported.
This local law predicts an already typed argument-slot conflict, not an unbound state change on an assumed event chain.
Internal substitution transfer retained an exact-pair advantage and did not bind meanings. No learned character substitution or parser-role vector is used here.
External substitution transfer failed its aggregate endpoint. This is a finite literal-frame/type constraint rather than reopening that vector transfer test.

Isolated substitutions do not establish an operator. This proposal explicitly limits any result to compatibility or rejection of one added writer; no operator meaning is inferred from surface substitution.

No paragraph pair had two disjoint literal anchors. This proposal neither changes that threshold nor repeats parallel-passage mining; it fixes one conditional local predicate frame from completed drafts before its census.
Directed backoff does not erase whole-form/context residuals. The opaque/local-scope rivals remain explicit, with zero substring gloss transfer.

smallest_decision_note.unknown: Does this exact guessed category predicate and NOT class admit the stated maximal atomic-argument writer outside their two development leaves, or do already fixed non-food values appear in the mandatory slot? No target census has been performed.
smallest_decision_note.decision_changed: A literal incompatible X removes this proposed extra writing constraint while preserving the underlying full readings for other grammar. Compatible-only data retain the narrow constraint provisionally without selecting a meaning. Empty/open-only data stop this one test without repair.
smallest_decision_note.minimum: A single exact-window census and independent reconstruction of source IDs, line flags, complete paragraph denominators and fixed type sets. No parameter optimizer, source-world interpreter or generative text search.
smallest_decision_note.stop: At a source hash or source-ID mismatch, forbidden selector, inability to retain complete paragraph references, unresolved fixed type classification, or the 20-minute total budget, stop and report the issue. No automatic predicate substitution, gap expansion, new noun value, coercion, target hunt or alternative scope.
smallest_decision_note.before_target_access: Root review and a separately registered selected test must precede target census. This RAW file is not execution authorization and does not assert capacity.

relations.detail: A named exact writer and argument-type falsifier.
Full comparative reading and short negated-food constituent.
Typed writing, now bound to fixed whole-form guesses; source-world construction remains separate.
No spelling-length, recurrence rank, shortening parameter, family threshold or result from GDT1031 is modified or scored.
